##### Project general facts 

Milos Residences is a residential building by Karma Developers, rising 13 storeys with a distinctive wave-like façade of curved balconies wrapped in white banding against a glass envelope. The architecture centres on a dialogue between indoor and outdoor living: poolside balconies and terraces run throughout the building, offering residents a retreat with views over the Dubai skyline. The development offers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed with an emphasis on modern elegance, natural light and a calm, uncluttered aesthetic — captured in the project's own positioning as "the gentle side of life."

Residents have access to an extensive set of amenities woven into the building itself, so daily life rarely needs to leave the premises. These include a swimming pool with poolside terrace, a fully equipped gymnasium, a sauna and steam room, a jacuzzi, a dedicated yoga and meditation space, and a kids' play area. A rooftop level adds an outdoor cinema and lounge seating for residents to unwind above the city. Practical touches extend to 24/7 security, a covered car park, and a suite of on-call services — housekeeping, car cleaning, a doctor and a nanny — designed to simplify everyday living. The lobby and lift areas are finished in marble and warm-toned panelling, carrying the same refined material language through to shared spaces.

Apartments are delivered unfurnished, with a full developer finish: fitted kitchens with stone countertops, tiled bathrooms with rainfall showers, and floor-to-ceiling glazing opening onto private balconies or terraces throughout the living areas and bedrooms.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is a low-density residential district laid out between Emirates Road and Al Ain Road. It combines a suburban, green setting — with two community hubs offering basketball and volleyball courts, children's play areas and landscaped seating — with efficient access to Dubai's key business and lifestyle destinations, making it well suited to both professionals and families.

The surrounding neighbourhood includes established communities such as Al Barari, The Villa, Villanova and Silicon Oasis, alongside a concentration of education and healthcare providers — Zayed University, Kent College, the University of Dubai, the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture and Fakeeh University Hospital are all close by. Everyday retail is covered by Silicon Central Mall and the Dubai Outlet Mall, while regular RTA bus services connect the area directly to the Dubai Mall / Burj Khalifa metro station. Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are all a comfortable drive away, alongside leisure destinations such as IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village and Dubai Miracle Garden.

Property here is held on a freehold basis, open to international buyers. Combined with Dubai's broader urban development strategy — which targets substantial growth in tourism infrastructure, public beaches, and healthcare and education land allocation over the coming years — the district is positioned to benefit from sustained population growth and, with it, ongoing demand for residential real estate.
